title: Retreat Reflection Publishing Lag
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:retreat retreat_name=* retreat_end_epoch=* reflection_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((reflection_epoch-retreat_end_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by retreat_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures reflection publishing lag by retreat for retreat follow-up.
value: Lag tracking shows which retreat create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside retreat follow-up.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `reflection publishing lag` on `faith:retreat` events and aggregate them by `retreat_name`.
visualization: Table of retreat with average and worst reflection publishing lag.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how long things take for each retreat so you can see where retreat follow-up slows down.
